title: Summit: a landing page for a Shopify planning tool
summaryLead: A landing page for a Shopify planning product.
story: Summit is for Shopify agencies and consultants. You give it scattered discovery notes and it hands back requirements, a risk assessment, a roadmap and a QA plan. Its users live in spreadsheets and inboxes, so the page has to show what comes out, not just describe it. We kept it light, with no framework. A paper grain sets the tone, and the workflow section and the score ring do the explaining.
goals: Explain the product in a few seconds.
Show what comes out, not only what goes in.
Keep the page light and quick.

features.title: Grain and fluid type
features.text: A paper-like grain, and headlines that scale smoothly from phone to desktop.
features.story: The grain is an SVG noise filter inside the page, so there's no image request. Headline sizes come from one clamp() instead of a pile of breakpoints.

features.title: Workflow
features.text: Discovery notes go in. Requirements, a risk assessment, a roadmap and a QA plan come out.

features.title: CSS score ring
features.text: A score ring drawn in CSS, with no chart library.
features.story: It didn't need Chart.js or D3 for one ring. It's a conic-gradient with a smaller circle on top, so it draws instantly.
